sampling.deterministic_seed_set: existing held-endpoint gravity, mirror and out-of-plane seeds

primary_predicate.name: COMPLETE_CANDIDATE_PREPARATION_QUALIFICATION
primary_predicate.definition: a selected force-balanced PSD-stable equilibrium exists and passes the frozen complete 11-component candidate guard v2

secondary_observations: complete candidate guard minimum and winner
winning contact category, branch and segment pair
stop_conditions: either endpoint contradicts its predeclared primary classification
no force-balanced PSD-stable equilibrium can be selected at a sampled alpha
the sampled primary predicate violates the declared monotone direction
formal source, overlay source, frozen specification or run-plan identity changes
claim_boundary: This map may bracket where the existing contact-free held-equilibrium preparation loses candidate qualification. It does not add contact forces, continue beyond contact, prove a unique continuum bifurcation, certify dynamics, or select a post-contact physical model.
